Studydown

Focused time, clearly recorded

Studydown turns time with your iPhone face down into a private Activity ledger for work, learning and daily life. Choose an Activity, start, then place the screen down.

A calm record for every kind of focus

  • Face-down timing

    Time is recorded whilst the iPhone rests face down. Pick it up to pause, then continue according to your timer settings.

  • Free: 3 Activities, 5 minutes

    Keep up to 3 Activities and 300 seconds (5 minutes) of total recorded time, with Today and This Week summaries and a basic CSV file. This is not a daily allowance. Lifetime Pro removes both limits; a face-down session already underway is saved without trimming.

  • Lifetime Pro

    A single lifetime purchase unlocks unlimited Activities, monthly, yearly and custom analysis, weekly goals, Deadlines, Apple Watch, Widgets, advanced hero styles, and complete JSON backup and restore. No subscription.

  • Private by design

    There is no account, developer server, advertising, analytics or tracking. Your app records remain on your device.

Contact

Explain what happened and include your device and iOS version. Please do not include private focus records.
